full_name: Teru Miyake | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Humanities Beatrice Shepherd Blane Fellow Nanyang Technological University (Singapore)
bio: Teru Miyake is an associate professor in the philosophy program at Nanyang Technological University, in Singapore. His research focuses on trying to understand the growth of scientific knowledge in the wake of criticisms raised against traditional notions of scientific progress by such philosophers as Thomas Kuhn, mainly through studying the history of sciences such as seismology, celestial mechanics, and physics.
